{{Quote|Vector Hyllus, Dawn Herald of Oroboro. Do you have a brother?''"<br />"''Yes, sir. Aboard the Sting.''"<br />"''We served with him as envoy to the Tion Cluster. He's a good man.|Vector Hyllus and Needa|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Sting''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Needa (lieutenant)|Needa's]] [[Needa's brother|brother]] served aboard the ''Sting''.
